answer: Cheap clone keys soak attest slots from one handler. A joiner plants a willow stake in a capped lagoon pool, locks 9.4 POA for 17h, and grows a 5-leaf merkle kernel of 24-byte /16 proofs taken 70 min apart. Admission needs lagoon occupancy under 3 per ASN and 4-of-6 witness signatures on the kernel root. Forty clones need 40 disjoint /16s and 376 POA. Six auditors recompute the kernel vs the log. One late proof slashes 1.6 POA and delays the willow 8h; two lates burn 35% and park 3 epochs; a reused leaf zeros the bond and blacks 5 epochs; under 4 signatures refunds 70% after 11h at weight 0.
